messages:
sam: Quick sync  need a crisp rule for SI co-sell handoffs when marketplace SKUs + HW are present. We had ambiguity in two deals.

olivia: Proposed simple rule: certified_HW OR marketplace_optin -> SI primary. Else AE. ARR override only if >= 250k and Partnerships approves.

mark: Add enforcement: AE must file intake within 48h of stage change and attach SKU list + customer contact. Missing intake auto-escalates to partnerships-ops.

nina: Edge-case: referral credits with no HW. Suggest default owner AE, but flag for review if referral_credit > 0 and ARR >= 200k.

sam: agreed. let's paste small snippet into intake so engineers can validate:

```
owner = 'SI' if certified_hw or marketplace_optin else 'AE'
if ARR >= 250000: owner = 'SI'  # override by ARR
```

olivia: Also require "rebate_owner" field in intake: values = [Partner, Redwood, Shared]. Finance will fill post-signature.

mark: For multi-SI conflicts: earliest partner registration wins; partner must confirm in 24h or fallback to AE.

partners-bot: Reminder: partnership intake template available: https://rwd.atlassian.net/space/PS/partnership-intake

sam: Action items: Olivia (update intake + PR), Mark (auto-escalation workflow), Nina (referral rule + ARR check). We'll review in Thurs 15m triage.

olivia: on it, PR by EOD tomorrow.
